purpose: Design proposal only; no Android implementation changed.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a precise user-flow design board using the TWO PROVIDED OFFICIAL PLEOS SCREEN REFERENCES. Reference1 is left vehicle / center navigation / right music. Reference2 is left vehicle / wide navigation taking the entire remaining right two thirds. Do NOT invent a different vehicle/navigation/media arrangement. Preserve original proportions, stock top bar and bottom climate/app dock from the references. Photo-based UI concept edits, not a new cockpit illustration. A landscape 2304x1536 professional presentation board in white, 2x2 grid of four large screenshots, each full screen shown uncropped. Small Korean captions above each. Keep screen examples visually consistent with source, actual stock OS styling, fixed LEFT vehicle column. No Charok branding imposed on system areas.
Heading "차록은 화면을 차지하지 않습니다". Small subtitle "글레오로 시작·기록·종료, 열어달라고 할 때만 우측에".
TOP LEFT cell caption "01  평소 · 차량정보 + 전체 내비". Use reference2 unchanged inside the cell. No Charok panel, no Charok popup.
TOP RIGHT cell caption "02  헤이 글레오, 차록 기록해줘". Use reference1: vehicle LEFT, navigation CENTER, music RIGHT unchanged. Add only one compact Android-style notification at top RIGHT of app area below statusbar, inside music's top part without changing music layout: brand small "차록", message "기록을 시작했어요". No Charok dashboard. The music is still visible with album/controls intact.
BOTTOM LEFT cell caption "03  차록 기록 종료해줘". Use same reference1 with exactly same three app regions. Add only compact notification at SAME top-right spot, message "기록을 저장했어요". Again NO Charok dashboard anywhere. Music remains visible. Small caption outside frame "저장 후에도 현재 화면 유지".
BOTTOM RIGHT cell caption "04  차록 열어줘". Use reference1 with ONLY right music content region replaced by polished WHITE narrow Charok app panel; preserve vehicle LEFT and native navigation CENTER. Small Charok header, "오늘 남긴 기록", saved status, "04:32", small timeline, "상담 카드 보기". It is parked 0/P as reference1. No fourth panel. Small outside caption "명시적 열기만 우측 콘텐츠 영역 사용".
Do not put user speech as a simulated Gleo screen over the entire cockpit; speech belongs in captions outside. Do not depict Charok's own microphone listening UI. Stock voice assistant might use native feedback, but do not invent it. Main point is unchanged existing app arrangement during start/record/end. Crisp legible text. Footer: "디자인 시안 · 실제 실행 아님 · 음성 분기·우측 지정·알림 위치는 Pleos 검증 필요". Do NOT claim these behaviors already work. Reuse official reference imagery only as conceptual layout context.

Use case: ui-mockup, precise-object-edit. The attached image is an OFFICIAL PLEOS CONNECT REFERENCE SCREEN. Make a design concept edit, NOT a claimed actual running app.
CRITICAL INVARIANTS: preserve the ORIGINAL screen structure, proportions and native visuals. The LEFT ONE THIRD is stock VEHICLE INFORMATION, MIDDLE ONE THIRD is stock NAVIGATION, RIGHT ONE THIRD currently MUSIC. Preserve the entire left vehicle-information region and central navigation region exactly as in the supplied image, including their DARK theme, car image, map controls, text, widths and locations. Preserve the original shared TOP STATUS BAR and BOTTOM HVAC/APP DOCK exactly. Do NOT redesign the stock UI, remove the vehicle area, swap the map and car, expand Charok beyond the existing right music panel, add a fourth column, or make a generic different cockpit. Do not redraw a map, route, car or music player inside Charok.
ONLY replace the content rectangle of the RIGHTMOST MUSIC APP with a high quality WHITE CHAROK dashboard, representing the explicit voice request "헤이 글레오, 차록 열어줘" after parking. Right panel begins near x=1370 of the 2048x1152 reference, below the top status bar and above the bottom dock; treat existing panel boundary as fixed. Exact full-image edit, keep full screen in view with no perspective hardware. Small added clean white margin BELOW the original display for a concept caption, not over the OS dock. Output high resolution at about 2048px wide so the narrow panel is readable.
The user rejected basic starter-app designs. Make this narrow single-column dashboard sophisticated and memorable through typography, rhythm, proportion, distinctive information visualization and restraint, not excessive decorations or a grid of equal cards.
RIGHT PANEL COMMON COPY: compact brand "차록"; tiny status "정차 중" and "예시 데이터"; elegant heading "오늘 남긴 기록"; status badge "저장 완료"; driver description "저속 회전 중 덜컥 소리"; date "11월 15일"; large time "04:32" labeled "기록 시간"; "표시한 순간 3"; three short timeline items "00:48 첫 번째 표시", "02:17 두 번째 표시", "03:56 세 번째 표시"; primary bottom action "상담 카드 보기", secondary text "기록 모아보기". A small close icon at upper right of Charok panel implies returning to former content. All content confined to this narrow right panel. No popup, no toast necessary in this open view. No voice waveform or diagnosis score, no fictional fault diagnosis, no "auto booking", no noisy TEST/debug controls.
In the extra footer outside screenshot, clearly label variant name plus: "디자인 시안 · 차록 열어줘 요청 때만 우측 패널 표시" and smaller "순정 영역은 참고 화면 · 우측 지정은 구현 검증 필요". Stock reference is attribution context; this is NOT an actual runtime screenshot.
VARIANT A: "A · SIGNAL / 정돈된 기록". Brand accent cobalt blue #3158D5, clean white #FFFFFF, near-black navy ink. Make panel a sophisticated automotive journal: elegant compact C-shaped blue brand mark; top clear saved status with tiny check; dominant 04:32 set in precise typography with small index 01; thin blue vertical timeline rail with three numbered milestones; driver note as a large typographic quote with a small blue side rule, not a bubble; generous but efficient spacing. One subtle cool-gray summary surface only, other sections connected with hairline dividers. Strong bottom blue button and quiet secondary. No busy sidebar in this narrow panel. Modern and highly legible.

A premium editorial archive identity using an elegant narrow bookmark glyph, warm fine rules, bold Korean sans serif body and expressive large editorial numerals. A small date tab along top; driver description as strong title, short "오늘 남긴 기록" label above; duration and moments on one horizontal metric line; slender vertical timeline with copper circular indices and small timestamps.
